correctness.rationale: Inspected all four-chart GF(2) Buchberger unit-ideal logic; vanishing of f,df/dx,df/dy over algebraic closure detects geometric singularities, so checking unit ideal on each chart tests smoothness without sampling extension fields. Independent custom lex Gröbner implementation checked all 4095 masks and independently SymPy-checked first 100, finding 1116 smooth. Independently enumerated all 44070 distinct triples {a,b,a xor b} of smooth sections and 9-point rational base histogram; independently reconstructed 36 action matrices and full 1242 orbit partition with frequencies 1,3,30,1208 for orbit sizes 6,12,18,36. Verified binomial-moment inversion (44070,62820,28512,3696,0), no >=4 rational base points. Adjunction genus (2−1)(3−1)=2, geometric intersection product 2*2*3=12. All universes finite and genuinely exhaustively enumerated, not extrapolated.
